Open 10 to 17 · Gallery 4 · 1887Open 10 to 17 · Gallery 4 · 1887

Old-style figures blend into the small caps; faked small caps (font-size on capitals) look thin and are the tell to avoid.
Signature
A second voice made of small caps: a whole navigation, date lines and gallery labels in a drawn small-caps sans, beside a calligraphic serif, both from one superfamily.
Use when
Museums, archives, universities, libraries, foundations, publishers with a back catalogue.
Turns into slop when
When small caps are faked by shrinking capitals, when every word becomes a small-caps label, or when a crest or seal is drawn in to look old.
